title: A retry decorator
hints: A decorator with arguments is three nested defs: retry(...) returns decorator(func), which returns wrapper(*args, **kwargs).
Inside wrapper loop `for attempt in range(1, times + 1)`: try to return func(*args, **kwargs); `except exceptions:` catches only the listed types.
On the last attempt use a bare `raise` to re-raise the same exception; otherwise call sleep(wait) and multiply wait by backoff.
Put @functools.wraps(func) on wrapper, and check `times < 1` before defining decorator so the ValueError fires at decoration time.
